verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              एतच्छ्रुत्वा महाबाहुः केशवः प्रहसन्निव। अभूतपूर्वं भीमस्य मार्दवोपहितं वचः ॥१॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said The long-armed Keshava heard with a glad heart these words fraught with mildness from Bhima. Being of opinion that such words from Bhima were as unusual as lightness of a mountain or coldness in fire, the younger brother of Rama, born in the race of Shura and wielding the Sharang bow, then encouraged Vrikodara with his words like wind encouraging flames and said to Bhima, who was seated and who was overwhelmed with his kindness.

verses.sanskrit: गिरेरिव लघुत्वं तच्छीतत्वमिव पावके। मत्वा रामानुजः शौरिः शार्ङ्गधन्वा वृकोदरम् ॥२॥
सन्तेजयंस्तदावाग्भिर्मातरिश्वेव पावकम्। उवाच भीममासीनं कृपयाऽभिपरिप्लुतम् ॥३॥
श्रीभगवानुवाच। त्वमन्यदा भीमसेन युद्धमेव प्रशंससि। वधाभिनन्दिनः क्रूरान् धार्तराष्ट्रान् मिमर्दिषुः ॥४॥
verses.english: The blessed God said 0 Bhimasena, at other times you approving of war rejoiced at the prospect of killing the crooked minded sons of Dhritarashtra, who oppress others.

verses.sanskrit: न च स्वपिषि जागर्षि न्युब्जः शेषे परंतप। घोरामशान्तां रुषतीं सदा वाचं प्रभाषसे ॥५॥
verses.english: You do not sleep but are awake with your face bent downwards, O you chastiser of your enemies; and you always speak terrible and wrathful words inclined towards war.

verses.sanskrit: निःश्वसन्नग्निवत्तेन संतप्तः स्वेन मन्युना। अप्रशान्तमना भीमं सधूम इव पावकः ॥६॥
verses.english: With your own worth, your breath is hot like fire and, O Bhima, your mind is not calm like fire with smoke.

verses.sanskrit: एकान्ते निःश्वसन् शेषे भारार्त इव दुर्बलः। अपि त्वां केचिदुन्मत्तं मन्यन्ते तद्विदो जनाः ॥७॥
verses.english: Alone and by yourself you sign in a corner like one labouring under a load; and those not aware of the cause thereof consider you to be insane.

verses.sanskrit: आरुज्य वृक्षान्निर्मूलान् गजः परिरुजन्निव। निघ्नन् पद्भिः क्षितिं भीम निष्टनन् परिधावसि ॥८॥
verses.english: Like an elephant breaking into pieces the uprooted trees which he has himself felled down and beating the earth with its feet, you too run about drawing sighs.

verses.sanskrit: नास्मिन् जने न रमसे रहः क्षिपसि पाण्डव। नान्यं निशि दिवा चापि कदाचिद‌भिनन्दसि ॥९॥
verses.english: Here you are not pleased with the company of men, but spend your time, O son of Pandu, in solitude; and nothing else ever delights you by day and by night.

verses.sanskrit: अकस्मात् स्मयमानश्च रहस्यास्से रुदन्निव। जान्वोर्मूर्धानमाधाय चिरमास्से प्रमीलितः ॥१०॥
verses.english: Sometimes you laugh aloud all on a sudden; and sometimes you sit weeping in a secluded spot; and sometimes again you are seated for a long time with your head between your two knees and with your eyes closed.
verses.bhavadeepa: अस्मिन् वने जनेन ब्राह्मणसमूहेन क्षिपसि नयसि कालमिति शेषः ॥९॥

verses.sanskrit: भ्रुकुटिं च पुनः कुर्वन्नोष्ठौ च विदशन्निव। अभीक्ष्णं दृश्यसे भीम सर्वं तन्मन्युकारितम् ॥११॥
verses.english: Other times with your eye-brows contracted and your lips firmly pressed against each other, you gaze at objects before you for a long time. All this is the work of wrath.

verses.sanskrit: यथा पुरस्तात् सविता दृश्यते शुक्रमुच्चरन्। यथा च पश्चान्निर्मुक्तो ध्रुवं पर्येति रश्मिवान् ॥१२॥
verses.english: As surely the sun is seen in the east rising and blazing forth his radiance and as surely that body of light afterwards sets after revolving round Meru; so truly shall I kill wrathful Duryodhana with a blow of this mace. war I speak this truly and there will be no swerving from this oath of mine. With this oath at one time did you handle the mace in the midst of your brothers. At this time however the inclinations of you, O chastiser of your enemies, who are such; point towards peace.

verses.sanskrit: तथा सत्यं ब्रवीम्येतन्नास्ति तस्य व्यतिक्रमः। हन्ताहं ग‌दयाऽभ्येत्य दुर्योधनममर्षणम् ॥१३॥
verses.bhavadeepa: शुक्रं तेजः निर्मुक्तोऽस्तं गतः ध्रुवं निश्चयं पुनः पर्येति मेरुं पुनः पुनः प्रद‌क्षिणीकरोति ॥१२॥

verses.sanskrit: इति स्म मध्ये भ्रातॄणां सत्येनालभसे गदाम्। तस्य ते प्रशमे बुद्धिर्ध्रियतेऽद्य परंतप ॥१४॥
अहो युद्धाभिकाङ्क्षाणां युद्धकाल उपस्थिते। चेतांसि विप्रतीपानि यत्त्वां भीर्भीम विन्दति ॥१५॥
verses.english: Alas! at the approach of the time for fight the hearts of those who are inclined towards will be swerved away; since fear penetrates you.

verses.sanskrit: अहो पार्थ निमित्तानि विपरीतानि पश्यसि। स्वप्नान्ते जागारान्ते च तस्मात् प्रशममिच्छसि ॥१६॥
verses.english: Alas, O son of Pritha, you see in your mind's eye the omens unfavourable to you, whether you are asleep or awake. Therefore do you desire peace!

verses.sanskrit: अहो नाशंससे किञ्चित् पुंस्त्वं क्लीब इवात्मनि। कश्मलेनाभिपन्नोऽसि तेन ते विकृतं मनः ॥१७॥
verses.english: Alas, you do not evince any manliness in you like an eunuch. You are overpowered by extreme fear; and therefore is your mind swerving from the right path.
verses.bhavadeepa: निमित्तानि महिषारोहणवामनेत्रस्फुरणादीनि स्वप्नान्ते स्वप्ने । जागरान्ते जागरे ॥१६॥

verses.sanskrit: उद्वेपते ते हृदयं मनस्ते प्रतिसीदति। ऊरुस्तंभगृहीतोऽसि तस्मात् प्रशममिच्छसि ॥१८॥
verses.english: Your heart shakes with fear; your mind is filled with despair; and your thighs tremble; and therefore do you desire peace.

verses.sanskrit: अनित्यं किल मर्त्यस्य पार्थ चित्तं चलाचलम्। वातवेगप्रचलिता अष्ठीला शाल्मलेरिव ॥१९॥
verses.english: O son of Pritha, the hearts of earthly men are inconstant and susceptible of change like a young Shalmali tree moved by the force of wind.

verses.sanskrit: तवैषा विकृता बुद्धिर्गवां वागिव मानुरषी। मनांसि पाण्डुपुत्राणां मज्जयत्यप्लवानिव ॥२०॥
verses.english: This perverted intention of yours is as unusual as the human faculties in a cow. The minds of the (other) sons of Pandu will sink (in an ocean of despair) like those without a race (and yet struggling in the waters).
verses.bhavadeepa: अष्ठीला फलान्तर्ग्रन्थिः सा च शाल्मलेः केवलं तूलमयी भवति ॥१९॥

verses.sanskrit: इदं मे महदाश्चर्यं पर्वतस्येव सर्पणम्। यदीदृशं प्रभाषेथा भीमसेनासमं वचः ॥२१॥
verses.english: It is to me as great a wonder as the lifting up of a mountain that you should speak worlds in this strain so unlike Bhimasena.

verses.sanskrit: स दृष्ट्वा स्वानि कर्माणि कुले जन्म च भारत। उत्तिष्ठस्व विषादं मा कृथा वीर स्थिरो भव ॥२२॥
verses.english: Looking back on your own deeds and the family in which you are born, O Bharata, rise up and do not yield to grief. O hero, be calm.

verses.sanskrit: न चैतदनुरूपं ते यत्ते ग्लानिररिन्दम। यदोजसा न लभते क्षत्रियो न तदश्नुते ॥२३॥
verses.english: This dullness which you evince is not fit for you; for a Kshatriya does not keep that which he does not win by force of his own might.
